messages:
jamie_sales: NorthBridge POC: logs/traces not joining in Splunk after S3 export. Can we triage quickly?
client_infra: S3 ndjson lines missing "trace_id" field. Our forwarder can't correlate. Also saw bursts of 429 from /v1/export during a load test at ~16:05.
omar_se: tagging frida + lee. Two common issues: header propagation missing, or exporter write storm causing some items to be written without mapped trace_id.
frida_sre: suggest quick fixes: 1) ask client to send X-Redwood-Trace-Id header with their trace id. 2) set route option preserve_trace_context=true and reduce export_concurrency to 1 for now.
client_infra: sample payload from S3 (redacted):
```json
{"ts":"2025-01-14T16:05:12Z","svc":"api","event":"query","attrs":{"path":"/v1/query","status":200}}
```
jamie_sales: their test curl is basic, won't set custom headers by default. We'll ask them to add header.
omar_se: route patch example: PATCH /v1/routes/northbridge-poc {"preserve_trace_context":true,"export_concurrency":1,"export_batch_size":20}\nfrida_sre: also increase retry_backoff_base to 8000ms to smooth retries and reduce 429 spikes.
deploy-bot: route patch requested: routes/northbridge-poc -> {preserve_trace_context:true,export_concurrency:1,export_batch_size:20,retry_backoff_base:8000} (deploy id d-9981)
deploy-bot: deploy d-9981: started
deploy-bot: deploy d-9981: succeeded :white_check_mark:
client_infra: after change: Splunk shows trace_id on ~98% of items, S3 ndjson includes trace_id. 429s during rerun are gone.
lee_security: noting KMS requirement for Dedicated exports. I'll send required IAM policy and SOC2 items to client contact.
jamie_sales: great. I'll schedule a security call and confirm CMK ARN. We'll keep sampling at 100% for 10m then scale down while monitoring exporter-429 rate in Console > Observability.
frida_sre: adding alert: exporter-429-rate > 0.3% for 5m -> page oncall.
jamie_sales: thanks everyone, closing the swarm unless new errors crop up.
